methodology: Four non-overlapping random batches, 50 icons each. Batch 1: seed 20260917, selected from 3,295 approved icons at its snapshot (44 solo, 4 container, 2 sub). Batch 2: seed 20260918, selected from 3,812 currently approved records after excluding the first 50; all 50 selected are solo. Batch 3: seed 20260919, selected from 3,762 currently approved records after excluding the first 100; 47 solo and 3 container. Batch 4: seed 20260920, selected from 3,712 currently approved records after excluding the first 150; 47 solo, 1 container and 2 sub. Each batch follows the gallery’s selected-artwork and approval precedence. All inspected SVG hashes match the captured approval versions. Review used native 48px/32px/64px and enlarged renders, supplied references, exact selected-SVG centerlines, and geometry evidence. Names were known; this is not a blind recognition test. YES requires all nine retained checks to pass. Meaningful asymmetry is accepted. Small construction differences are not automatic failures: the native-size impact matters. Logo identity is assessed against supplied references rather than claimed public recognition. Specific named actions or qualifiers must be supported, and an unresolved intended concept receives NO pending clarification. These are local snapshots and AI design judgments, not a population-quality estimate or a usability study.
qa_note: All 200 baseline Python models passed fresh automated QA. 196 inspected SVGs match those models exactly. The selected gallery edits for one-chilli and pie-food differ from their baselines and each separately passed fresh QA on the exact edited graph. The uploaded bookmark and acoustic-guitar differ from their baselines; model passes do not validate these uploads. The guitar review includes an exact selected-SVG envelope measurement. Original references are linked where available. Reference/name conflicts and mismatching source depictions are documented in the affected analyses. Existing artwork and approval records remain unchanged.
